title: What Are the Best Countries for Expats
paragraphs: Which countries are the best places to live and work abroad? According to a new survey of people living in foreign countries, the answer is Panama, in Central America.

The survey is called Expat Insider 2026, and it was done by InterNations, an online community for expats, or people who live outside their home country. The survey asked almost 8,000 expats from 162 countries about their lives. It looked at five areas: working abroad, personal money, quality of life, everyday things such as visas and housing, and how easy it is to settle in. A country needed at least 50 people to answer the survey to be included. In total, 31 countries were ranked.

Panama was first for the third year in a row. It was second for how easy it is to settle in and for expat essentials, such as dealing with visas. About 87% of expats in Panama said they were happy, compared with 70% around the world. In addition, about one in three expats there want to stay in Panama forever.

Mexico was second. It was first for how easy it is to settle in, because people there find it easy to make friends and feel welcome. Thailand was third. In Thailand, 85% of expats were happy with the low cost of living, and 42% want to stay there forever. It is also easy to find cheap housing in Thailand.
The rest of the top 10 were the United Arab Emirates, Brazil, Spain, Singapore, Portugal, Malaysia and Luxembourg.
At the bottom of the list, the UK was 28th, Türkiye was 29th and Germany was 30th. Norway was last, in 31st place.
The survey was done between February and March 2026, so it does not show changes that happened after the war between the US and Iran.
